title: Senior Software Engineer
description_html:
Headquarters: Beloit, WI
URL: http://acculynx.com

Senior Software Engineer

AccuLynx is a fast-growing SaaS provider of business management software for roofing contractors. With more than 10 years in the business and impressive year-over-year revenue growth, we have quickly established ourselves as the leading software product in this multi-billion dollar industry.

AccuLynx is actively looking for smart and passionate Senior Software Engineers to join our growing Engineering team! We are headquartered out of Beloit, WI and would love to have you join us for major planning sessions and meetings, but this role has the option to be remote. We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to have mastered at least one language and be eager to master any technology or language in the future. If you want to be part of a collaborative team committed to providing a best-in-class software user experience, please read on!

What You Will Do:

  • Support Engineering team in delivering well-written, well-tested code to complete new features or address issues in the product
  • Collaborate on the design, implementation, testing and review of new features and fixes
  • Review code and contribute feedback to improve the quality, readability, and testability of the code base across Engineering
  • Architect, design, develop, deploy and operate services that serve AccuLynx’s thousands of users
  • Use Agile process to experiment and improve on software development practices at AccuLynx

What might you work on?

  • Implement real time communication tools to connect our customers.
  • Create a fast and responsive work-scheduling application for use in the field.
  • Build an automation platform so our customers can customize their workflow to reduce wasted movement.
  • Solve advanced mapping and geolocation problems.
  • Build out our public RESTful API.
  • Review junior Engineering team members’ work for accuracy and provide coaching and feedback
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Your Qualifications:

  • Top notch coding skills
  • 7-10 years of software development experience
  • 7+ years of full-stack web development: frontend, backend and database
  • Smart and gets things done
  • Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
  • Belief that performance is a feature
  • Experience with our stack: Vue.js, C#, Sql Server, Redis, ElasticSearch, Git
  • Confidence you will make a difference in our product
  • Leverages AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging workflows while maintaining high code quality standards
  • Actively evaluates and integrates emerging AI coding assistants into the team's development process, sharing best practices to improve overall engineering velocity

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
  • Understanding of HTML5 and mobile responsive development.
  • Contributions to OSS projects or Stackoverflow.
  • Availability for after hours support. We work at a sustainable 40h/week pace but sometimes things go bump in the night.

Why We Love AccuLynx:

AccuLynx’s success as the #1 business management software for roofing contractors over the past 11 years is thanks to us investing in our employees, maintaining company values and focusing on a strong company culture. Our positive work environment has allowed us to retain employees that have been with us since our company’s inception and has provided the solid groundwork for us to develop an industry-leading product while exceeding our customer’s expectations. Because of our commitment to our company values and culture, we were recently officially recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified™ organization, with 90% of our employees naming AccuLynx as a great place to work.

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for software, product and company culture achievements. Our team’s shared belief in AccuLynx's mission promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation and fun. We have built a benefits program to match the strength of our team. This program includes:

  • Attractive compensation packages
  • Flexible paid time off - 3 weeks off in your first year!
  • Competitive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401K matching and safe harbor contributions

Our Interview Process:

We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to be a master of your domain and be eager to learn any technology or language in the future. We aim to reply to your application within a week of receiving it. Our interview process consists of several stages, each one allowing us get to know you better, professionally and technically. It is also an opportunity for you to gain a better understanding of our culture and the work we do at AccuLynx. The stages include:

  • CV, open source code, or public portfolio review
  • Phone interview with HR team
  • Face to Face conversation with a few members of your team.

Applicants must be able to work legally within the United States. Please, no 3rd party inquiries.

AccuLynx is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion and employing a diverse workforce. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/acculynx-senior-software-engineer

title: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Foundations
Software Engineer – BP&A
Founding Full Stack Engineer, Creator Services
description_html: The Opportunity   This position where we will develop and launch a new product within Adobe working within an exciting org that is incubating next-generation ideas. Build the next generation agentic AI platform working with a research scientist, designers, and a venture lead to bring the new product to life.  This role is an outstanding opportunity to operate like a startup founding engineer while having the resources of an innovative, large Technology company. Join us for an opportunity to invent new technologies and power a brand-new product that serves emerging creators.   The Challenge   We are looking for a Founding Full Stack Engineer to build Creator Services from the ground up. Creator Services is building AI-powered audience intelligence: given a content idea and creator context, predict whether it will resonate and surface the insights that help creators make smarter decisions. As Creator Services expands into brand deal discovery, negotiation, storefront management, and affiliate programs, the research agenda grows with it.  A core part of the platform will be agentic AI systems that automate the complex tasks creators face running their businesses. You will build and operate multi-agent pipelines. You will transform model outputs into interactive creator workflows. This will connect Creator Services to creator platforms and data sources that make the intelligence real. Collaborate closely with the Research Lead and Product & UX Lead as a peer collaborator.   Responsibilities    Product Build (Front-to-Back): Build the mobile-first creator app and micro-studio (front-end) and the services behind it (back-end/APIs), turning research and product vision into a live product creators use daily. Stack: React / React Native or Flutter on the front-end; Python and/or Node/TypeScript on the back-end.  Develop and manage multi-agent pipelines and prediction serving. This includes cost-efficient inference, caching, and graceful degradation when model providers falter. Also, include eval instrumentation to catch regressions in production.  Model Productionization: Collaborate closely alongside the lead researcher to transform model outputs into responsive, low-latency creator workflows. Support deployment of trainable model components alongside base model APIs (Azure OpenAI) on Colligo (Adobe's ML platform).  Integrations: Build integrations with external creator platforms (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok via creator-authorized OAuth), Adobe's wider suite of creative tools (Express, Firefly, Adobe Creative Suite, IMS), Semrush, and internal Adobe services.  Data Pipelines: Build the data pipelines that feed the audience intelligence, insight, and prediction engines — including the outcome-feedback loop that lets the system learn from real creator results.  Architecture Ownership: Own architecture decisions as an early hire — from framework choices to data models to deployment pipelines  Observability & Reliability: Contribute to monitoring, observability, and evaluation frameworks that ensure AI-driven features behave reliably and transparently for creators.    What is needed to succeed    5+ years shipping full-stack products end-to-end (front-end + back-end + APIs) — startup or 0→1 experience strongly preferred.  Proficiency in a modern back-end environment like Python or Node with TypeScript is required. Experience with a contemporary app/front-end stack such as React, React Native, or Flutter is also necessary. Mobile-first experience is a strong plus.  Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs and agent frameworks; solid grasp of latency, cost, evals, and fallbacks in production — not just prototypes.  Experience designing and building scalable APIs, backend services, and data pipelines from scratch.  Comfort with cloud infra (Azure/AWS/GCP) and standing up services in a resource-constrained startup environment.  Ability to move fast under ambiguity, own outcomes end-to-end, and work effectively in a small, flat team.  A genuine interest in the creator economy and the tools creators use to build their businesses.    Bonus    Experience with third-party social/platform APIs (YouTube Data API, Instagram Graph API, TikTok for Developers).  Familiarity with the Adobe ecosystem — Firefly APIs, Adobe IMS, Creative Cloud integrations.  Experience with recommender or ML-serving systems; Colligo or similar ML infrastructure.     About Adobe   Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.   Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.     Let’s Adobe together   At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our    values and culture   ,    focus on people, purpose and community   ,    Adobe for All   , comprehensive    benefits programs   , the    stories we tell   , the    customers    we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.   Adobe is proud to be an    Equal Employment Opportunity    employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.    Learn more.      Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email    accommodations@adobe.com   .    AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:  Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.   At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about    AI in the hiring experience   .      Expected Pay Range:  Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets.
